decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API extends the firm's existing messaging platform at low marginal cost and has had its own page for two years, which points to ongoing commercial relevance.
The email-to-SMS gateway was launched only in 2024, reuses the firm's core messaging infrastructure and serves existing enterprise customers, so dropping it would save little.
The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B and the inbound API within an integrated communication suite, and it is cheap to maintain on the shared platform.
